name: LoD-NeuS
definition: LoD-NeuS is a neural implicit surface reconstruction method that encodes features with a continuous level of detail (LoD) from a tri-plane-based representation to adaptively reconstruct high-fidelity geometry and address aliasing concerns.
summary: LoD-NeuS is a neural implicit surface reconstruction method that uses multi-scale tri-plane encoding to reduce aliasing and MLP queries while preserving high-frequency detail.
